IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives O'Brien, Condotta, Wood and Darneille

Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the moorage period for sales tax exemptions for nonresident vessel purchasers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales tax exemption for vessels purchased bynonresidents; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and providingan effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of vesselsthirty feet or longer to residents of foreign countries, and otherstates, for use outside of this state, even though delivery is madewithin this state, but only if the vessel owner purchases and displaysa valid "use permit" issued by the department. A use permit may not beissued to any vessel registered in Washington state nor may one beissued for any vessel not registered to individuals in a foreigncountry or another state. A corporation as a registered owner of avessel may not be issued a use permit under this section. Thedepartment is authorized to impose a fee for a "use permit." A usepermit may be issued for twelve consecutive months from the date ofissue. A buyer at the time of purchase must make an irrevocable p. 1 HB 3077election to take the exemption authorized in this section or theexemption in either RCW 82.08.0266 or 82.08.02665.
